description:
Create a new Property Set in JFrog Artifactory named 'build-info' and assign it to the 'example-repo-local' repository. 

The Property Set must contain the following 3 properties:
1. 'build.status' (Single Select) with predefined values: 'passed', 'failed', 'in-progress'
2. 'target.env' (Single Select) with predefined values: 'dev', 'staging', 'production'
3. 'build.number' (Any value/Text)

Steps:
1. Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 (admin / password).
2. Navigate to Administration > Repositories > Property Sets.
3. Create the 'build-info' property set with the properties described above.
4. Navigate to Administration > Repositories > Repositories > Local > example-repo-local.
5. Edit the repository configuration to add the 'build-info' property set (look in the Basic or Advanced tabs).
6. Save your changes.
